content:
令

\[
L=\lim_{x\to+\infty}\left[\frac{x^n}{(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-n)}\right]^x
\]

取对数：

\[
\ln L=\lim_{x\to+\infty}x\ln\left(\frac{x^n}{(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-n)}\right)
\]

而

\[
\frac{x^n}{(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-n)}
=\prod_{k=1}^n \frac{x}{x-k}
=\prod_{k=1}^n \left(1-\frac{k}{x}\right)^{-1}
\]

所以

\[
\ln\left(\frac{x^n}{(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-n)}\right)
=-\sum_{k=1}^n \ln\left(1-\frac{k}{x}\right)
\]

当 \(x\to+\infty\) 时，

\[
-\ln\left(1-\frac{k}{x}\right)
=\frac{k}{x}+O\left(\frac{1}{x^2}\right)
\]

因此

\[
\ln\left(\frac{x^n}{(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-n)}\right)
=\frac{1}{x}\sum_{k=1}^n k+O\left(\frac{1}{x^2}\right)
=\frac{n(n+1)}{2x}+O\left(\frac{1}{x^2}\right)
\]

于是

\[
\ln L=\lim_{x\to+\infty}x\left[\frac{n(n+1)}{2x}+O\left(\frac{1}{x^2}\right)\right]
=\frac{n(n+1)}{2}
\]

所以

\[
L=e^{\frac{n(n+1)}{2}}
\]

答案：C
